Official libghostty Wasm Engine

Features·seedling·proposed·AUG 16, 2026

Kolu parses PTY bytes with Ghostty's official ghostty-vt.wasm — tiles and the daemon screen-mirror share one engine.

Contents

  • Why this package
  • Two consumers
  • Pin

The live VT engine is official ghostty-vt.wasm from Ghostty GitHub releases (the pre-built asset cited in Mitchell Hashimoto’s 2026-08-14 note). @xterm/xterm and @xterm/headless are not that engine.

Why this package

Wasm load, C ABI, linear memory, and function-table callbacks are a hard volatility. @kolu/ghostty-kit hides them. Tests call createEngine with bytes in and plain text / VT / snapshot out — no DOM, no PTY.

Two consumers

  • kaval — per-PTY screen-mirror, attach snapshot + getHistory, OSC cwd / title / command-run.
  • client tiles — the same engine plus a canvas renderer in @kolu/ghostty-kit/solid.

Pin

packages/ghostty-kit/vendor/PIN.md names the release URL and SHA-256. Missing wasm is a crash, not a fallback.
